is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Culex pipiens, not Anopheles mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not genotype any insecticide-resistance markers; it performs larvicidal bioassays and molecular docking.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses Culex pipiens, not Anopheles.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study on the synthesis and larvicidal activity of silver nanoparticles.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new study on nanoparticle synthesis.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is required as the paper is ineligible.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the synthesis of silver nanoparticles using olive cake hydrolysate and their larvicidal activity against Culex pipiens. It does not study Anopheles mosquitoes or genotype any insecticide-resistance markers.
